mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_group (name, group_code, owner_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{groupCode}, #{ownerId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_group WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM sys_group WHERE group_code = #{code} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT g.* FROM sys_group g INNER JOIN group_member m ON m.group_id = g.id AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE g.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY g.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_group SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_group SET owner_id = #{ownerId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
